price_usd_mw.source: Argo->Galaxy Helios: $65M facility sale (Dec 2022) implying ≈$325k/MW on a ~200MW-designed site (MW figure ≈); CleanSpark comparable distressed-site pricing $270-500k/MW

real_examples.name: Core Scientific Chapter 11
real_examples.note: filed owing hundreds of millions; continued mining through bankruptcy; emerged 2024-01-24 with ~$400M debt equitized; relisted with 724MW operating capacity

real_examples.name: Compute North Chapter 11
real_examples.note: owed up to $500M; fixed-rate hosting contracts prevented pass-through of 2022 power-cost spike -- direct trigger; Crusoe bought a $1.55M asset tranche, Generate Capital bought CN's stake in 2 mining facilities

real_examples.name: Celsius Mining -> Fahrenheit/US Bitcoin Corp
real_examples.note: structured as a management-fee deal ($35M + $15M mgmt fees) over ~12.2 EH/s / 121,800 rigs, not a clean per-MW sale

real_examples.name: Argo Blockchain -> Galaxy Digital (Helios, TX)
real_examples.note: $65M facility sale + separate $35M term loan from Galaxy (~$100M total bailout package); this same site later became the CoreWeave-leased Helios AI campus worth $15B in contracted lease revenue -- a 230x value-creation arc from raw site to AI-leased asset

real_examples.name: Greenidge Generation
real_examples.note: avoided bankruptcy via debt restructuring with NYDIG ($11M+, Jan 2023), not a sale

price_usd_mw_announced.source: market-implied at deal-announcement stage; Cipher Mining's 313MW priced at $2.9M/MW (Jun 2026) vs Digital Realty's stabilized AI benchmark of $27M/MW -- miners trade at 8-14 cents on the dollar vs stabilized AI infra

real_examples.name: Core Scientific-CoreWeave (Denton, TX expansion)
real_examples.note: $1.2B expansion tranche on top of the original 200MW/12yr deal

real_examples.name: CoreWeave unsolicited bid for Core Scientific
real_examples.note: ~$1B all-stock initial offer, later increased; rejected by CORZ shareholders Oct 2025 -- good rival-interaction texture

real_examples.name: IREN-Microsoft (Childress, TX)
real_examples.note: 200MW (4x50MW tranches), $9.7B/5yr AI cloud deal incl. GPU compute -- 20% prepayment; IREN separately buys ~$5.8B of Dell/Nvidia GB300 hardware to fulfill

real_examples.name: Cipher Mining-Fluidstack (Barber Lake, Google-backed)
real_examples.note: 168MW critical IT, 10yr (+2x5yr), ~$3B initial (~$7B w/ extensions); Google backstops $1.4B, takes ~5.4% CIFR equity via warrants

real_examples.name: Hut 8 Beacon Point (undisclosed hyperscaler)
real_examples.note: 352MW IT, 15yr, $9.8B base term ($25.1B incl. all renewal options); pure triple-net colo, full 1GW campus fully contracted by Jul2026 at $19.6B

site_categories.price_usd_mw: land + interconnection deposit only, ≈$0.5-2M/MW upfront (site control) before any shell capex (see conversions.json greenfield_ai_shell for build cost)

queue_position_lost.label: Interconnection queue position must be re-filed
queue_position_lost.basis: PJM ~7yr average wait (electricchoice.com); losing queue position on a re-purposed distressed site is a real, documented risk

water_limits.label: Water permit / cooling capacity limit
water_limits.basis: liquid-cooled AI retrofit needs far more water than ASIC air-cooling; several 2025-26 siting fights cite water use explicitly

fibre_distance.label: Nearest fibre backbone is 15+ miles away
fibre_distance.basis: AI shell conversions need far more network bandwidth than mining; remote crypto sites often lack it

air_permit_for_gas.label: On-site gas turbines need an air permit fight
air_permit_for_gas.basis: xAI Memphis Colossus: unpermitted gas turbines, NAACP/SELC legal action 2025-26

zoning_challenge.label: Zoning approval vulnerable to a procedural challenge
zoning_challenge.basis: Prince William Digital Gateway: zoning voided by a court over a newspaper-notice technicality; Compass and QTS/Blackstone both exited in 2026

tenant_unfit_power_quality.label: Power quality (harmonics/voltage sag) unsuitable for GPU racks without conditioning
tenant_unfit_power_quality.basis: ≈ mining-grade power delivery is less clean than what dense GPU racks need; a plausible, under-documented but realistic flaw

undersized_transformer.label: Undersized transformer inherited from the mining era
undersized_transformer.basis: carried over from Act I sites.json flaw of the same name, scaled to Act II costs

title_defect.label: Distressed-sale title/lien not fully cleared
title_defect.basis: ≈ typical bankruptcy-auction risk; several 2022-23 crypto-miner asset sales carried disputed liens
